goal: Expose per-peer message-processing CPU usage in getpeerinfo and netinfo
Help node operators spot resource-heavy or abusive connections and evaluate peer scheduling
reviewability: Author silent 160 days; review may wait a long time for a response
agreement: Unaddressed objection: CPU metrics are not actionable or comparable, prefer clock time (ajtowns)
Nonblocking objection: exploratory metric belongs in experimental RPC, needs decaying average (sipa)
Support for anti-DoS visibility and paving way for peer prioritization (jonatack, laanwj, mzumsande)
Verified by testing in getpeerinfo and netinfo during Signet IBD (jonatack, BrandonOdiwuor, yuvicc)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it adds a new diagnostic metric to getpeerinfo for monitoring connection resource usage
Provides visibility into abusive peers and data for peer prioritization, but is not urgent
